item.text: The animation will use a payment receipt and a checkmark, with a brief upward entrance and a drawn check. It will finish in under a second, with a still success state for reduced-motion settings.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('payment-sent.svg')
r = ET.parse(p).getroot()
assert r.attrib['viewBox'] == '0 0 128 128'
s = p.read_text()
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' in s
assert 'infinite' not in s
assert '<script' not in s
print(f'Valid SVG: {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes; one-shot animation ends at 720 ms; static reduced-motion state.')
PY
rg --files /opt /usr/local/lib /tmp /root/.cache 2>/dev/null | rg '(playwright|puppeteer|resvg|chromium|librsvg)' | head -25"
